transcript: Speaker A: This guy just built an app while running the Amsterdam marathon. Meet Tijs. Six months ago, he was just a self-taught developer vibe coding with his voice using Wispr Flow for dictation, and he realized if he could build without a keyboard, maybe he didn't even need to be at a desk. And without a second thought, he tied a MacBook to his back and put on some XR glasses, turning the streets of Amsterdam into his office. But Tijs wanted more. He wanted to push the limits and inspire people to build. So obviously, the only logical decision was to build an app while running the Amsterdam marathon. On October 19th, he shows up at the starting line looking like he came straight out of a Black Mirror episode with all this gear. And the first few kilometers feel smooth. Voice prompts are hitting, screen is clear, and then his laptop disconnected. But what is Tijs even building? Well, it's called Hypes, and it's exactly what he needs at this moment: a voice-based hypeman that keeps him from quitting. It talks back, listens, and pushes him. But slowly, things actually start clicking. The app stops crashing, and he starts building momentum. By kilometer 35, he's literally and metaphorically flowing, pushing code and adding some final touches to his app. And before he's even able to admire his finished product, in the process of crossing the finish line at kilometer 42, he's already getting interviewed on national TV about the app he just built while running a full-on marathon. But this was never about running or shipping lines of code. It's about showing that anyone, anywhere can start building. And if Tijs can build an app with his voice while running a marathon, what's stopping you from building yours from your couch?

summary: The ad showcases Tijs, a developer who built a voice-controlled app called 'Hypes' using Wispr Flow while running the Amsterdam marathon. By utilizing XR glasses and a backpack-mounted laptop, he proved coding can be done anywhere. The video serves as an inspirational call-to-action for viewers to start building their own apps.
